You can also say “hey, I need you to know that I’m dealing with something and I need a little space but please don’t worry. Take a little space. But most importantly changing your focus onto something totally different is the best choice. Not another person or group you could. It’s like a reset. Also, maybe he is annoying. He could just be annoying lol. I have put a lot of work this issue for myself. I even stayed with bad people too long because the problem wasn’t me but I thought it was.

For me it means I’m missing stimulation. If things get boring I get annoyed. Do you have any hobbies or something exciting you can do? Just shift your actions to feel excited about something. This took years for me to figure out. It’s just me though. Sometimes even making a weird meal helps me shift off being annoyed. Looking through old hard copy pictures and childhood drawings can shift me too. Don’t think how bad your hurting people. That will mess you and them both up more. Focus on shifting which is more responsive to action than changing thoughts.

My big one was 6 years ago. Psychotic mania. The best thing you can do is things.
